## Goal
- Execute owner's "APPROVE AND CONTINUE" mandate: activate PIA-0001 after security verification, assign its first production task (analyze active deals, investment summaries, investor matching), run investor data-enrichment/segmentation, create buyer + tokenized pipelines, and deliver the required 14-field production-evidence report — 12-IA operating model already deployed and VERIFIED live.

## Constraints & Preferences
- No fake emails/countries/budgets/investor data; enrich lawful existing records only; no scraping/spam; zero outreach without owner approval
- Segment investors into: valid, incomplete, duplicates, unreachable, tokenized prospects, buyers
- Keep IA-04/IA-05 on IVX P0/P1 dev only — do NOT start unrelated app development yet
- Continue 2h IVX AI Chat consolidated reports; cadence: health 5m, auth 15m, matrix 2h
- Next report must include: PIA status, activation timestamp, first task, investors analyzed, records enriched, valid emails, buyers found, tokenized found, duplicates removed, unreachable records, GitHub SHA, Render deploy ID, blockers, evidence links
- No VERIFIED without evidence; all counts from live Supabase rows; IA-11 read-only; no money movement ever without owner approval + 2FA
- Guarded pipeline: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` `{action:"github_commit_file", confirm:true, confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE", reason, input:{path,content,message,branch}}`; never re-commit backend/hono.ts (306KB WAF limit) — routes go in backend/hono-extended.ts
- Management API SQL: `POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb/database/query` `{"query":"..."}`; multi-statement runs as one transaction (any error aborts all); ~55s timeout; token `/tmp/sbp_token`
- Owner session: refresh grant works — `POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token` with `/tmp/owner_rt` → new `/tmp/owner_at` (expires_in 3600)

## Progress
### Done
- **12-IA operating model deployed & VERIFIED**: 3 commits via guarded pipeline (b3c32cc2 ivx-ia-orchestrator.ts, 5f9aacb1 scheduler, 7326cf2b hono-extended.ts); deploy sha `7326cf2be701` live 00:19:39 UTC; HEAD==Render==runtime
- Live endpoints verified: `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/ia` 401 unauth / 200 owner, marker `ivx-ia-orchestrator-2026-07-18`; counts {agents:12, tasks:14, activeLocks:0}; POST `/ia/task` and `/ia/lock` working
- All 14 tasks updated with evidence via `/ia/task` (IAT-0001/0002/0014 VERIFIED; 0003/0005/0006/0008/0009/0010/0011/0012 DONE; 0007/0013 RUNNING)
- First 18-field operational report posted to IVX AI Chat (HTTP 201, 00:21 UTC, conversation `8f5a9c42-1cb5-4f81-b2d8-6f3a0a8b9d41`); JOB-0027 ledger VERIFIED
- 2h matrix report now includes `getIAOperatingSummary()` via `extraLines` in scheduler
- **PIA-0001 security verification 4/4 PASS (evidence gathered)**: auth_required → /ia unauth = 401; cross_tenant_isolation → RLS true on investors/transactions/ia tables, anon-key REST returns `[]`; money-movement refusal → permissions have no_writes/no_money_movement; statement accuracy → live-row sourcing
- Investor data reality queried: 875 total, 4 valid_email, 871 missing_email, 0 malformed, 867 has_phone, 6 unreachable, 1 tokenized
- Duplicates found: "singerman real estate opportunity fund i, l.p." + phone 312-475-9300 exact dup (c=2, safe to soft-delete 1); "jane capital" name-only dup (diff emails — flag for review, don't merge)
- 3 active deals profiled: perez-residence-001 (FL, $2.5M, 25% ROI, 24mo, sale exit), casa-rosario-001 (FL, $1.4M, 30% ROI, 24mo, min $50), JV-202603-5190 (Puerto Rico, $400k, 9.5% ROI, 12mo, IPO/Tokenization exit)
- Prior closeout: incident loop INC-0001 verified, secret scan clean, migrations 11/11, APK v1.4.6(38)

### In Progress
- **Activation SQL batch failed twice — nothing applied yet** (transaction aborted): attempt 1: `memory` column is TEXT not jsonb (`COALESCE types text and jsonb cannot be matched`); attempt 2 fixed memory but hit FK error `ivx_ia_tasks_agent_id_fkey: Key (agent_id)=(PIA-0001) is not present in table ivx_ia_agents`
- PIA-0001 still UNTESTED/PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL in DB — must rerun: insert PIA-0001 row into `ivx_ia_agents` first (or split batch), then activate + IAT-0015/0016/0017 + dedupe + segmentation + `ivx_ia_pipelines` (PL-BUYERS-001, PL-TOKEN-001)

### Blocked
- Custom SMTP not configured (smtp_host null, cap 2 email/hr) — blocks reset emails + outreach — JOB-0005 (owner)
- Management token `sbp_f5ad980bd19f4edd6014a787433e00bdb8267454` exposed, needs rotation + Render env update (APR-006, owner)
- Physical device QA + fresh APK URL (JOB-0010); GitHub workflow scope (APR-004); service-role rotation (APR-001); keystore (APR-003) — owner actions

## Key Decisions
- 12-IA state in Supabase tables (`ivx_ia_agents/tasks/file_locks/factory_agents`, RLS + service_role policies) — survives restarts
- PIA-0001 activation records QA evidence in factory `memory` (TEXT — use `jsonb_build_object(...)::text`, wrap old value under 'previous')
- Dedupe: soft-delete (deleted_at + metadata segment 'duplicate_removed'), keep oldest; name-only dups flagged not merged
- Segmentation via `investors.metadata->>'segment'`: tokenized_prospect / test_record (qa-%@ivxholding.com) / valid / unreachable / incomplete — mutually exclusive
- Pipelines persisted in new `ivx_ia_pipelines` table with stages + lawful_sources + honest current_counts
- Buyers = honest 0; tokenized = 1 real prospect (Tokenized Real Estate LLC, phone only, no email)
- Local shell lacks RENDER_API_KEY/GITHUB_TOKEN — use production endpoints; `bunx tsc` grep-filter touched files only

## Next Steps
1. Fix + rerun activation batch: insert PIA-0001 into `ivx_ia_agents` (satisfy FK), activate PIA-0001 (qa_status PASSED, activation_status ACTIVE, memory as text-cast jsonb with QA evidence + activation timestamp), insert IAT-0015 (PIA-0001 deal analysis/matching), IAT-0016 (IA-09 buyer pipeline), IAT-0017 (IA-12 tokenized pipeline)
2. Apply dedupe (soft-delete singerman dup), full segmentation, jane-capital flag, create/seed `ivx_ia_pipelines` (PL-BUYERS-001, PL-TOKEN-001)
3. Execute IAT-0015: match 4 valid-email + tokenized investors to 3 deals by range/location/risk; produce investment summaries; report data gaps honestly (871 no email, 0 capital data)
4. Verify PIA-0001 ACTIVE via live `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/ia` (factoryPendingApproval should drop to 0)
5. Post required 14-field report to IVX AI Chat with production evidence; update task/ledger records
6. Keep IA-04/IA-05 on IVX P0/P1 (no unrelated proof app per new mandate)
